concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-br-payment-capabilities]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree Brazil-path installment-payment snapshot covering checkout-selected 2–12-month plans, 30-day customer debit and merchant payment cadence, even disbursement with final-installment remainder, required integration updates and transaction-level dispute treatment; no stated currency or merchant-account eligibility rule, and not universal/current Braintree or PayPal support, another region's capability, or payment, settlement, disbursement or funding proof
warnings: Keep the article's capability statements scoped to the collected Brazil path and 2026-09-16 snapshot; the page does not specify currency, card brand, API or SDK version, environment, or merchant-account eligibility.
Do not transfer the sibling Brazil Overview's Braintree Direct and Braintree-funded-account portal condition into a universal installments eligibility rule.
